scenarios.name: Retain a customized command size while switching tabs

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible
Shell uses the Standard button size in the Modify panel
the user chooses Large from the Shell button size menu
the user selects the Tools tab and then returns to 3D Model
Shell is still shown as a large button
its button size menu marks Large as selected
the user chooses Standard from that menu
Shell returns to its standard button presentation
